## Types of changes
<!--- Put an `x` in all the boxes that apply. -->

- [ ] 🐞Bug fix – A non-breaking change that resolves an existing issue.
- [ ] ✨New feature – A non-breaking change that introduces new functionality
- [ ] 💥Breaking change – A change that alters existing functionality in a way that is not backward compatible.
- [ ] 🧼Code Cleanup -  Code refactoring or improvements with no functional impact.
- [ ] 📖Documentation – Updates or additions to documentation only.
- [ ] 🛠️Tooling - fix or add tools in the repository to build / lint / ...

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit subjects follow Conventional Commits (`type(scope): summary`); they make the release changelog.
- [ ] A breaking change ends its subject with `[breaking]` and has a `BREAKING CHANGE: <what operators must do>` footer.
- [ ] A change of the bridge configuration or of the chart values is reflected in `docs/configuration.md` and `charts/ldap-scim-bridge/values.yaml`.
